hypothesis: Using the adjacent Q/K heads in the existing QKV projection as a single rotary input should reduce eager per-token dispatch with equal pixels.
strategy: Apply the existing BF16 operations to the packed Q/K head group. Split into contiguous Q and K after rotation; V is passed through.
alternatives: Use a hardware-specific fused rotary kernel. Its rounding on partial BF16 heads would need separate validation on each backend.
Cache cosine/sine tables across decode steps. Different M-RoPE positions and request lifetimes require an additional indexing and invalidation protocol.
selection_reason: The previous native AR stage takes about 46.7 s/image. Packed Q/K retained exact output bytes for one and 32 tokens and lowered the one-token 40-layer section from 18.59 to 11.41 ms; it needs no device-specific kernel or cross-request cache.

retrieved_items.title: Qwen-Image-2.1 eager text-to-image on one 910B1: reuse plus interleaved RoPE, 30% not met

quality: Compare native stock RGB SHA-256 for seeds 107, 42 and 771. Independently render the teapot at seed 43 and require a different hash from seed 42. In both quality arms save all four images as lossless PNGs, decode to uint8 RGB and compare each candidate pixel with baseline.
